sentence: This project studies how airborne pollutants attach to nanoplastics and how these particles reach the brain in rodent models.
This project tests whether a liver organoid model made from human stem cells mirrors the livers of patients with steatohepatitis.
This project builds a partnership to fight cancer among Indigenous communities and improve their health outcomes.
This project studies how demethylation controls the way cells change their fate during differentiation.
This project builds tools to purify viruses and to count how many virus particles are in a sample.
This project studies ways to lower cancer risk, find cancer early, and reduce illness and death among patients with cancer and survivors.
This project uses a data structure called a succinct tree sequence to improve computer methods for storing and analyzing genomic data.
This project studies how proteins in host cells shape the outcome of infection with a DNA virus.
This project uses long-read sequencing and computer methods to study how tandem repeats and structural variants affect drug abuse in rats.
This project builds a way to watch for early signs of outbreaks among people who inject drugs.
This project uses animal models to study an enzyme that kills intestinal stem cells and ways to block it to reduce a transplant complication.
This project provides mouse models and tests in mice to check gene editing treatments for disease.
This project studies how a family of proteins works in neuronal signaling, thermoregulation and neurodegeneration.
This project builds a tool to quickly detect bacterial biofilms on shoulder implants.
This project studies how obelisks, self-replicating circular RNAs in bacteria, copy themselves and affect their bacterial hosts.
This project supports a conference on imaging technologies used in medical diagnostics and treatment.
This project works with large, complex data from biomedical research and medical practice to understand molecular processes and improve care.
This project tests whether nanoparticles can calm brain inflammation that drives Alzheimer's disease, using stem cells and human brain organoids.
This project builds ways to deliver prime editing tools into the body without viruses to edit the human genome.
This project studies the signaling pathways that cause cysts to grow in polycystic kidney disease.
